attachments.origin_landmark: median fibrous septum of the tongue
attachments.insertion_landmark: submucous fibrous tissue at the lateral margin of the tongue

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Works with the vertical fibres as an antagonistic pair: together they let the tongue change shape at constant volume, which is the muscular-hydrostat mechanism it shares with an elephant's trunk.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

ultrasound_injection_approach.transducer_placement: Not an ultrasound-guided technique -- injected directly, via an intraoral/transoral needle approach into the tongue substance, under EMG guidance (a hypodermic EMG needle electrode). Used only as an adjunct when the dominant lingual-dystonia pattern (usually genioglossus-driven protrusion) is accompanied by tongue curling/narrowing that the extrinsic-muscle injection alone does not correct.
ultrasound_injection_approach.depth_layer: Approximately 10 mm depth, injected bilaterally into the muscle running transversely from the median septum to the lateral lingual margin.
ultrasound_injection_approach.identification_cues: EMG confirmation of recruitment during the dystonic curling/narrowing movement; correct electrode placement verified before injection.
ultrasound_injection_approach.notes: Only ever described as one component of an individualized, EMG-mapped injection plan for lingual dystonia (protrusion type with curling), not as a standalone BoNT indication -- transverse tongue is not a typical or independently-targeted BoNT muscle. Total lingual-muscle dose per session averaged ~43 U, split across whichever combination of genioglossus/intrinsic muscles the EMG mapping indicated; reported here with that context rather than a muscle-specific dose.
ultrasound_injection_approach.source: Yoshida K, 'Botulinum Neurotoxin Therapy for Lingual Dystonia Using an Individualized Injection Method Based on Clinical Features', Toxins (Basel) 11(1):51 (2019), doi:10.3390/toxins11010051 -- retrieved via PubMed.
